sloka: एष सेतुर्मया बद्धः सागरे सलिलार्णवे ।तव हेतोर्विशालाक्षि नलसेतुः सुदुष्करः ।। ६.१२६.१२ ।।
transliteration: eṣa seturmayā baddhaḥ sāgare salilārṇave ।tava hetorviśālākṣi nalasetuḥ suduṣkaraḥ ।। 6.126.12 ।।

translations.english: "Yuddhonmatta and Matta both Rakshasa chiefs, and also Nikumbha and Kumbha, sons of Kumbhakarna (killed by Hanuman and Sugriva), and Vajradamshtra and Damshtra (killed by Angada), and Maha raksha who was difficult to encounter was killed by me in the combat."
translations.hindi: उस समय सीता को देख कर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का क्रोध पुनः उसी प्रकार भड़का, जिस प्रकार घी डालने से अग्नि धघक उठता है
